title: CE-SSCFC_Algs: reference implementation of classifier-embedded semi-supervised collaborative fuzzy clustering with validation-gated knowledge transfer
description:
NumPy-only reference implementation of CE-SSCFC (classifier-embedded semi-supervised collaborative fuzzy clustering). A ridge classifier on a fixed quadratic feature map is an optimisation variable of the fuzzy clustering objective; datasites collaborate only through per-class sufficient statistics of their labelled pixels (G_k, h_k, n_k), transferred through a validation gate and accepted by a backtracking rule that keeps the local validation risk non-increasing (Theorem 2 of the paper). The repository contains the algorithm (closed-form U/V/W updates, Phase 1, gating, Phase 2), evaluation metrics, a self-contained synthetic multi-datasite demonstration, tests, and an example that runs the paper's protocol on the companion Landsat-8 dataset (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22304965).

Companion code of: X. H. Nguyen, Q. B. Vuong, V. H. Tran, C. T. Nguyen, T. L. Hoang, Classifier-embedded semi-supervised collaborative fuzzy clustering with validation-gated knowledge transfer for multi-region land-cover classification, submitted to Neurocomputing (2026).
